nodes.speaker: character-commander
nodes.line: The rock unfolds. Halcyon plates slide apart, and a Ward-Engine rises out of the hill to face you.

nodes.speaker: class-knight
nodes.line: It shrugged off a sword. Check what it's weak to before we waste another swing.

nodes.speaker: class-redmage
nodes.line: Lightning. It's built to answer lightning. Stand back.
